title: Uniform lower Lipschitz bound for an injective C¹ immersion on a compact set (step 2, lower bound)
statement: Let P, d ∈ ℕ, let U ⊆ ℝ^d be open and K ⊆ U compact, and let g : ℝ^d → ℝ^P be C¹ on U (ContDiffOn ℝ 1 g U). Assume g is injective on K and Dg(z) = fderiv ℝ g z is injective for every z ∈ K. Then there is m > 0 such that m|a − b| ≤ |g(a) − g(b)| for all a, b ∈ K (Euclidean norms).
lean_statement: ∀ (P d : ℕ) (g : Euclid d → Euclid P) (U K : Set (Euclid d)), IsOpen U → IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 g U → InjOn g K → (∀ z ∈ K, Injective (fderiv ℝ g z)) → ∃ m : ℝ, 0 < m ∧ ∀ a ∈ K, ∀ b ∈ K, m * ‖a - b‖ ≤ ‖g a - g b‖
